title: Florida House, District 25
what_it_does: Represents District 25 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Incumbent Republican Taylor Yarkosky won the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Farmer Banks Helfrich on Nov. 3.
verified_ballot_note: Central Florida Public Media's Aug. 18, 2026 live results: 'House District 25: Incumbent Republican Taylor Yarkosky won his primary and will face Democrat Farmer Banks Helfrich' (https://www.cfpublic.org/live-updates/live-updates-primary-election-day-in-central-florida). Whether an NPA or write-in also qualified was not verified. Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.

candidates.name: Taylor Yarkosky
candidates.background: Incumbent Republican state representative for HD 25 (Lake County), first elected in 2022. Won the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary.
